name: Camp Wa-Klo
description_short: Overnight summer camp for girls in Dublin, NH, with 2-, 3-, 4- and 7-week stays for rising grades 2-10 and a Leadership Training Group for girls entering grade 11. Horseback riding is available at extra cost.

sessions.name: Second Session (2 Weeks) - Nouveau 2-Week Program, space limited

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: Horseback riding costs extra on top of tuition: 1 period/day is $1,950 (1st session), $1,850 (2nd session), $3,800 (full summer); 2 periods/day is $3,900 / $3,700 / $7,600. Riding spots are limited.

Grade limits for the shorter stays: the First Session 3-Week and Second Session 2-Week options are open to rising grades 2-5 for multiple years, but rising grades 6-7 can take them only once. The 2-week option is for rising grades 2-7 only.
Transportation costs extra: van from/to the New York area or Boston Logan airport transfer, $175 one way or $275 round trip.
Camp appears to be girls-only (all-female counseling staff; LTG is 'for girls entering Grade 11'), but the page does not say this outright.
